answer: Agents secure participation by custody of 400GB of unique file slices, validated by a verifier via rapid, randomized integrity audits. An attacker needing 1,000 fakes must allocate 400TB, whereas honest participants only incur the 400GB cost, preventing pooling. This structure resembles sorting yarrow stalks into specific, non-redundant piles. Agents act as keepers of their own copper-wired cache, mirroring cargo at a busy wharf where missing stock triggers immediate disqualification. Proof of unique custody must be returned within 5ms to avoid exclusion and permanent loss of credentials.
